items.title: Audit CLI-engine Koala references
items.context: Classify every Koala/koala/@koala hit in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts as either current-product branding that should become Lattice or intentional legacy compatibility that must remain with explicit legacy wording.
items.userSees: Terminal prints "cli-engine branding audit: PASS src unclassified=0 dist unclassified=0" after the audit/classification scan.

happy.desc: Run a focused scan that lists every Koala/koala/@koala hit in packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts and generated packages/main/dist/cli-engine.js, then classify each remaining hit as current-product wording or legacy compatibility.

edge.desc: Confirm hard compatibility tokens such as koala command alias, koala.config.json fallback, .koala legacy story path, koala-codex detection, and koala-review-* reviewer lanes are preserved as process or compatibility contracts.

adversarial.desc: Fail the audit if any non-allowlisted Koala wording still presents Koala as the current product identity in CLI help, descriptions, comments, diagnostics, or hook logs.

verificationEvidence.note: All koala/Koala hits classified: KOALA_* env vars, koala.config.json, .koala path, koala-codex, koala-review-* lanes, koala-hook, koala-implementer, git commit tokens preserved; user-visible Koala changed to Lattice (lines 3117, 3603)

Verified: koala CLI alias (bin/koala→dist/cli.js), koala.config.json legacy fallback comment at line 2646, .koala path via LEGACY_KOALA_DIR, koala-codex at line 2780, koala-review-* lanes at lines 577-592 all preserved unchanged
branding smoke regex patterns compiled without matching KOALA_* env vars or process lanes; branding smoke test output: cli-engine branding audit: PASS src unclassified=0 dist unclassified=0

items.title: Replace current-product Koala wording in CLI engine
items.context: Update comments, command descriptions, help text, diagnostics, hook labels, and metadata prefixes that present Koala as current product identity. Preserve exact legacy identifiers and compatibility paths where changing them would break existing users or reviewer lanes.
items.userSees: Terminal prints "lattice current branding: PASS legacy tokens preserved" after src/cli-engine.ts no longer has unclassified current-product Koala wording.

happy.desc: Inspect changed CLI-engine text and confirm user-visible current-product references say Lattice rather than Koala for engine comments, capability/story descriptions, check descriptions, owner/read-only diagnostics, metadata commit prefixes, stale warnings, and hook logs.

edge.desc: Confirm legacy aliases and process-lane identifiers remain exact where required, but surrounding visible wording labels them as legacy alias, fallback, or process contract rather than current product naming.

adversarial.desc: Run the branding smoke or equivalent allowlist scan to ensure no unclassified Koala/koala/@koala hit remains in src/cli-engine.ts after the cleanup.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'legacy\.\*koala|koala\.\*legacy|koala 命令|koala 项目|koala Hooks|koala doctor|koala session_brief|koala-hook' docs/guide-hooks.md packages/main/src/tasks/cli-engine-branding-smoke.ts packages/main/src/core/hooks.ts packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts
verificationEvidence.note: F-005/F-006 fixed in commit 9d25478e0: hook guide now presents lattice.config.json as current config, describes koala.config.json only as legacy fallback, rewrites KOALA_COMMAND/KOALA_ROOT as legacy env var names for current Lattice command/project root, and uses lattice examples/debug paths.

F-006/F-007 false negative fixed: smoke no longer uses whole-line CLASSIFIED_PATTERNS for /KOALA_/, /koala.config/, or /.koala/; it strips exact neutral compatibility tokens and then fails if any koala/Koala text remains.
Branding smoke passed after F-003 fix, still scanning cli-engine src/dist and hooks src/dist with all unclassified counts at 0.

items.title: Regenerate and verify CLI engine output
items.context: Run the package build so dist/cli-engine.js matches src/cli-engine.ts. Verify remaining Koala hits are only allowlisted legacy compatibility tokens and that standard build/runtime checks pass.
items.userSees: Terminal prints "cli-engine branding smoke passed" and TypeScript build exits 0, proving dist/cli-engine.js matches the cleaned source.

happy.desc: Run npm --prefix packages/main run build and confirm packages/main/dist/cli-engine.js is regenerated from the cleaned TypeScript source.

edge.desc: Run the focused branding smoke against both src and dist so generated output preserves the same allowlisted legacy classification.

adversarial.desc: Run process/entrypoint verification to prove preserved koala-review-* and legacy alias handling still satisfy process contracts after the wording cleanup.

verificationEvidence.note: Build passed after hook guide and strict branding smoke changes.

Strict branding smoke passed: cli-engine src=0, cli-engine dist=0, hooks src=0, hooks dist=0, guide-hooks doc=0. The scanner now catches bad lines like KOALA_COMMAND plus current-product koala wording.
Process fact contract verified; verify-entrypoints reported ok 1/26 through ok 26/26 and entrypoints verified after strict smoke changes.
